idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Fixed builds that silently produced no .beam files: a missing Erlang build plugin, a failing erlc or a module without rebar.config is now reported instead of ending as "successful" (#1077, #1028)
  • Fixed erlc warnings with column numbers (OTP 24+) being reported as errors and failing the build
  • Fixed build order for parse transforms when the IDE and JPS project names differ
  • Fixed false 'multi-valued comprehension' error on map comprehensions (#1093)
  • Quick documentation for OTP functions, types and modules works with the new erlang.org documentation (OTP 27+), including links between pages; documentation is downloaded using the IDE proxy settings
  • Parameter name hints are shorter (parameter name, spec name or a short pattern summary) and can be turned off in Settings | Editor | Inlay Hints | Parameter names | Erlang (#1064)
  • IntelliJ 2026.3 support
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 29 syntax and native records
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 28 comprehension generators, based float literals and nominal types
  • Added support for Erlang/OTP 27 sigil string literals
